jsonld_raw.name: (125 G) COFFEE CREAM SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Coffee Cream I The fragrance opens with the deep intensity of coffee, evoking the humid and fertile smell of the earth where coffee plantations are born, rich and dark under the shade. In the heart, vanilla provides a warm and enveloping softness, like the temperate air that sweeps through the plantations at dawn. The base of Peruvian balsam leaves a resinous and amber trail that recalls living, warm, and deeply rooted earth.

Olfactory notes:
Top notes: coffee.
Heart notes: vanilla. 
Base notes: Peruvian balsam.
